description: This update fixes Copy/Paste Tool interactions and fluid transfers, expands network support for UtilityCraft extensions, and makes crafting recipes accept more material variants.
highlights:
- Copy/Paste Tool works while standing or sneaking without opening machine inventories.
- Crafting recipes accept more wood, wool, sand, and stone material variants.
- Fluid transfers correctly preserve the liquid type when filling empty tanks.
- Steel progression has clearer forge assembly and Iron Dust instructions.
- UtilityCraft extensions can use shared network routes and compatible energy cables.
